codebase-memory.description: Deterministic code knowledge-graph over the SEOSONA OS repo (chosen code-nav MCP). Tools: search_graph, query_graph, trace_call_path, get_architecture, get_code_snippet, detect_changes (blast-radius), get_graph_schema, search_code, list_projects, index_status, manage_adr, ingest_traces. Project name: D-SEOSONA-AI-SEOSONA-OS. Re-index after big changes: npm run codegraph:index

seosona-knowledge.description: Semantic (TF-IDF) search over the SEOSONA knowledge base (3_MEMORY/knowledge_items, incl. all ~1,200 UAP-harvested KIs). Tool: knowledge_search(query, limit) -> {backend, results:[{title, portablePath, score}]}. Warm-started from the persisted index at 3_MEMORY/vector_index. Rebuild after big UAP runs: python -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'1_CORE/scripts/core');from vector_memory import SemanticMemoryEngine as E;e=E();e.build_index();e.save_index()"
